# Forges: GitLab, Gitea and Forgejo
GitHub, GitLab, and Gitea/Forgejo adapters exist.
Escalation and hold writes select an adapter, but enumeration still starts from GitHub.
Agent execution and proxy enforcement are not end-to-end non-GitHub.
